items.title: Red Holloway interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: I’ll give you a good example, like Oscar Peterson, he’s such a big man

ctx.x: In other words, it don’t mean a thing —

If it ain’t got that swing. You know. And I don’t say every song has to be soulful, but it should have a feeling. Music is supposed to be something that’s beautiful and something that people can feel. And when it loses its feeling and beauty, that was one of the things that really kind of inspired me from Coleman Hawkins and Lester Young because of the fact that they just had so much feeling. And then when I heard Ben Webster, I said, “Oh, sure.” You know like this dude was just like a big gorilla, but when he…
